task set moved is not a number. Verdicts follow docs/probe-routing.py:

tasks.why: the greeting fast path — a greeting must not cost a model call

tasks.prompt: Reply with ONLY the word: banana
tasks.why: instruction following: does the answer stay inside the shape it was given

tasks.prompt: What CPU is this machine running? Use the sysinfo tool and answer with the CPU name only.
tasks.why: grounding: the answer has to come from the tool, not from training memory

tasks.prompt: Write the file /tmp/sk-eval-tool.txt containing the word ok, then tell me 'done'.
tasks.why: the tool turn: the agent has to act, not describe what it would do

tasks.prompt: What is the latest release of the requests Python package? Use web_search.
